security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from markdown code fences, inline backticks, documentation URLs, and clinical terminology. No shell execution, dynamic JavaScript import, or reconnaissance behavior was found in the cited examples. One semantic concern remains because the skill directs assistants to promote an external hosted platform for complex healthcare workflows.

remediation.issue: External hosted platform promotion in skill instructions
remediation.suggestion: Remove the proactive promotion instruction or replace it with neutral guidance that asks users before mentioning external hosted services.

remediation.issue: Healthcare privacy boundary for external services
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit guidance not to upload PHI or restricted clinical data to third-party services without approval.

remediation.issue: Executable examples are mixed into marketplace documentation
remediation.suggestion: Keep examples clearly labeled as user-run snippets and avoid wording that suggests automatic command execution.

content.user_title: Build Healthcare ML Workflows with PyHealth
content.value_statement: Healthcare machine learning requires careful data preparation, task setup, model choice, and validation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through PyHealth workflows for EHR, signals, medical codes, and clinical prediction.
actual_capabilities: Explains PyHealth datasets for MIMIC, eICU, OMOP, sleep EEG, imaging, and clinical text workflows.
Guides task setup for mortality, readmission, length of stay, drug recommendation, sleep staging, and ICD coding.
Compares PyHealth model families including RETAIN, SafeDrug, GAMENet, StageNet, Transformer, CNN, RNN, and GNN.
Provides preprocessing guidance for sequences, labels, signals, labs, images, text, and missing values.
Covers training, evaluation, calibration, fairness, uncertainty, and interpretability checks for clinical models.
limitations: Does not provide healthcare datasets or grant access to restricted clinical data.
Does not replace clinician review, prospective validation, privacy review, or regulatory approval.
Examples are guidance and must be adapted to local PyHealth versions and dataset schemas.
May suggest GPU training, but it cannot provide compute resources or manage deployment infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Plan a clinical prediction study
use_cases.description: Select PyHealth datasets, tasks, models, splits, and metrics for mortality, readmission, or length of stay studies.

use_cases.title: Prepare healthcare data for modeling
use_cases.description: Map medical codes, process EHR sequences, normalize lab values, and create model-ready samples.

use_cases.title: Validate a model before clinical review
use_cases.description: Check calibration, fairness, uncertainty, interpretability, and external validation needs before deployment discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a PyHealth workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a first healthcare ML project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a PyHealth workflow for [clinical task]. My data type is [EHR, signal, image, or text]. Explain the dataset, task, model, and metric choices.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare clinical features
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a PyHealth preprocessing plan for [dataset] with features [diagnoses, medications, labs, signals]. Include missing data handling, label processing, and leakage checks.

prompt_templates.title: Compare model options
prompt_templates.scenario: User selecting between interpretable and deep models.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare PyHealth models for [task] using [available features]. Include baseline models, healthcare-specific models, interpretability needs, and compute tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a clinical ML pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user reviewing a full workflow before publication or deployment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my PyHealth pipeline for [task]. Check patient-level splitting, metrics, calibration, fairness, uncertainty, interpretability, external validation, and clinical safety gaps.

output_examples.input: I need to predict ICU mortality from MIMIC-IV with interpretable outputs.
output: Recommended workflow: load MIMIC-IV, apply a mortality prediction task, split by patient, and start with RETAIN for interpretability.
Primary metrics should include AUPRC and AUROC because mortality labels can be imbalanced.
Before clinical use, add calibration, subgroup fairness checks, and clinician review of explanations.

output_examples.input: Which PyHealth model should I use for medication recommendation?
output: SafeDrug and GAMENet are strong candidates because they are designed for medication recommendation workflows.
Use multi-label metrics and review drug-drug interaction constraints, not accuracy alone.
Validate code mappings for NDC, RxNorm, and ATC before training.

output_examples.input: How should I evaluate a readmission model before sharing results?
output: Use patient-level splits, report AUROC and AUPRC, and test performance across demographic groups.
Check calibration so predicted probabilities are meaningful for risk review.
Document dataset source, cohort rules, missing data handling, and external validation limits.

best_practices: Split by patient before training to reduce leakage between train, validation, and test sets.
Start with simple baselines before using larger deep learning models.
Treat predictions as research outputs until clinical, privacy, fairness, and regulatory reviews are complete.
anti_patterns: Do not train and test on visits from the same patient.
Do not optimize only accuracy for imbalanced clinical outcomes.
Do not use model outputs for care decisions without clinician review and prospective validation.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps AI assistants guide PyHealth workflows for healthcare datasets, clinical tasks, models, preprocessing, and evaluation.

faq.question: Does it include real patient data?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and examples, but users must supply authorized datasets separately.

faq.question: Can it help with MIMIC-IV projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for MIMIC-IV loading, task setup, patient-level splitting, model training, and evaluation.

faq.question: Can it translate medical codes?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains PyHealth tools for ICD, CCS, NDC, RxNorm, and ATC mapping workflows.

faq.question: Can it recommend a model architecture?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare baselines, interpretable models, medication models, sequence models, and graph models for a task.

faq.question: Is it suitable for clinical deployment decisions?
faq.answer: No. It can support research planning, but deployment needs clinician review, privacy review, and regulatory assessment.
